description: This PHP class 'TableReader' is responsible for parsing and loading table definitions from an XML representation (likely from an XLSX spreadsheet file) into PHPSpreadsheet's worksheet and table objects. It reads table properties, filters, columns, and styles from XML and applies them to PHPSpreadsheet objects.

classes.name: TableReader
classes.description: A PHP class to read table data from XML and populate PHPSpreadsheet worksheet objects with table, style, filter, and column data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TableReader with a Worksheet object and a SimpleXMLElement representing the table XML.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the table into the worksheet if the range is valid.

methods.name: readTable
methods.description: Creates and configures a Table object from the XML data, including auto filter, columns, and style.

methods.name: readTableAutoFilter
methods.description: Configures the table's auto filter settings based on XML.

methods.name: readTableColumns
methods.description: Reads and applies column settings, including totals row labels and formulas.

methods.name: readTableStyle
methods.description: Reads style information from XML and applies it to the table.
